Theme settings apply to the whole store. Open them from Online Store › Themes › **Edit theme**, then select the gear icon (**Theme settings**) in the sidebar.

This page lists every setting with its default in the **Attar** preset. Other presets start with different values; see [Presets]({{ site.baseurl }}/presets/).

## Colors

### Color schemes

Each color scheme is a set of colors. The store uses the **Page color scheme**, and visitors in light mode can see the **Light mode scheme** instead. Select **Theme settings** › **Colors** › a scheme to edit its colors.

The defaults below are for a new scheme. Each preset comes with four ready-made schemes; see [Presets]({{ site.baseurl }}/presets/).

#### Page

| Setting | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Background** | Color | #0E0C0A |  |
| **Surface** | Color | #141110 |  |
| **Raised surface** | Color | #1C1815 | Image placeholders, tiles and quiet panels. |
| **Text** | Color | #E8DCC4 |  |
| **Secondary text** | Color | #C9BFAF |  |
| **Muted text** | Color | #A89F92 |  |

#### Accent

### Scheme choice

| Setting | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Page color scheme** | Color scheme | Scheme 1 | Used across the store. Keep text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or higher against each background. |
| **Switch scheme for devices in light mode** | On/off | Off | Shows the light mode scheme to visitors whose device is set to light mode. |
| **Light mode scheme** | Color scheme | Scheme 2 |  |

### Arabic text

Fonts from the Shopify font library include Latin letters only, so Arabic text uses the fonts already on the visitor's device. Choose the style for each role.

| Setting | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Arabic headings** | Choice | Naskh (classic) | Options: Naskh (classic); Sans (modern). |
| **Arabic body text** | Choice | Sans (modern) | Options: Sans (modern); Naskh (classic). |

### Size

| Setting | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Type scale** | Slider | 100 % | From 90 to 110 %. |

## Effects

Store-wide switches for the signature effects. Section settings still apply, and the stricter choice wins.

| Setting | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Smoke** | Choice | Subtle | Options: Off; Subtle; Full. Incense smoke on the home hero, password page, mobile menu, page not found and empty search. Off removes it and skips its files. Subtle is lighter than each section’s density. |
| **Note display** | Choice | Note ribbon | Options: Note ribbon; Classic notes list; Off. Note ribbon draws each scent over time on product pages and cards. Classic notes list shows top, heart and base notes instead, without the card strips. Off hides both, and the scent pyramid block lists the notes. |

## Campaign

Dress the store for a season. The accent color and smoke take a seasonal tint, and the announcement bar and home hero accent line show a greeting while their text is blank. No offers or discounts are added.

| Setting | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Campaign** | Choice | None | Options: None; Ramadan; Eid; Saudi National Day; UAE National Day. |
| **End date** | Text |  | Optional. Enter as YYYY-MM-DD in your store’s time zone. The campaign switches itself off after this day. Leave blank to keep it on until you change it. |

## Floating widgets

| Setting | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Widget zone** | Choice | Bottom, end side | Options: Bottom, start side; Bottom, end side. The only floating area on the page. It never covers the add-to-cart bar. |
| **Widget order** | Text | whatsapp,back_to_top | Comma list: whatsapp, back_to_top |
| **Show WhatsApp** | On/off | On |  |
| **WhatsApp number** | Text |  | International format, for example +971500000000 |
| **Prefilled message** | Text |  | Leave blank to use the default message for each language. |
| **Raise widgets by** | Slider | 0 px | From 0 to 120 px. Lifts the widget zone above a bar pinned to the bottom of the screen by an app, for example a cookie or chat bar. Leave at 0 if nothing sits there. |

## Payments

Regional text badges (mada, Tabby, Tamara, valU) shown next to your store's payment icons. Turn on only the methods your store offers; each is hidden in markets where it isn't available.

| Setting | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **mada** | On/off | Off |  |
| **Tabby** | On/off | Off |  |
| **Tamara** | On/off | Off |  |
| **valU** | On/off | Off |  |
| **Cash-on-delivery markets** | Text |  | Comma list of country codes, for example AE,SA,EG |

## SEO and sharing

Controls what search engines, social apps and AI shopping assistants see. Search title, description and URL for each product, collection, page and article are edited in Shopify admin, in that item's "Search engine listing" section.

### Page titles

| Setting | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Title separator** | Choice | Vertical bar ( \| ) | Options: Vertical bar ( \| ); Dash ( – ); Long dash ( — ); Middle dot ( · ); Slash ( / ). Goes between the page name, page number and store name, for example "Royal Oud \| ATTAR". |
| **Add store name to page titles** | On/off | On | Skipped when the title already contains the store name. |

### Social sharing

| Setting | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Default share image** | Image |  | Used when a page has no image of its own. 1200 × 630 px works best on WhatsApp, X and Facebook. You can set a different home-page image in Online Store › Preferences. |
| **X (Twitter) username** | Text |  | Shown as the site account on X link previews. |

### Brand

| Setting | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Brand logo** | Image |  | Square or wide logo on a plain background, at least 112 × 112 px. Google can show it next to your store in results. It also appears on the gift card page, and as the sharing image for pages without one. |

### Indexing

Search results, cart, account pages, filtered or sorted collections and anything hidden with the seo.hidden metafield are always kept out of search results.

| Setting | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Hide tag pages from search results** | On/off | Off | Turn on if your tag pages are thin copies of their collections. Leave off if you use tags as landing pages, for example occasion shelves. |
| **Hide page 2 and later from search results** | On/off | Off | Usually best left off so search engines can still reach products deeper in long collections. |

### Structured data

Machine-readable details that help Google show prices, stock and ratings, and help AI assistants describe your scents. Turn one off only if an app already adds the same type.

| Setting | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Organization (home page)** | On/off | On |  |
| **Website and search (home page)** | On/off | On |  |
| **Breadcrumbs** | On/off | On |  |
| **Products** | On/off | On | Includes every variant's price, stock, SKU, barcode, size and price per ml, plus fragrance notes and ratings when they're filled in. |
| **Blog articles** | On/off | On |  |

Per-product details come from metafields. In Settings › Metafields and metaobjects › Products, add the attar.notes_top, attar.notes_heart, attar.notes_base, attar.concentration, attar.longevity and attar.sillage definitions. In Variants, add attar.volume_ml. Ratings are read from your reviews app's standard reviews.rating metafields. The theme documentation has the full list.
